info.title: UTF-8 and Unicode Analysis API
info.summary: Validate and inspect UTF-8, Unicode text, and JSON.
info.description: Strict, bounded analysis for hidden characters, mojibake, normalization, mixed scripts and confusables, text counts, JSON syntax, and Unicode code points. Requests are not persisted or forwarded by application code.

get.description: Returns deployed engine, hidden-ruleset, and runtime Unicode versions. Query parameters are rejected and this endpoint does not consume quota.

post.description: Reports invisible, formatting, bidirectional, whitespace, and control characters with exact offsets. Findings never include a raw character field.

requestBody.description: Strict envelope; profile is accepted only by this endpoint.

200.description: Hidden-character analysis completed or original bytes were invalid UTF-8.

findings.title: Zero-width space
findings.explanation: This character has no visible width and can separate otherwise adjacent text.

post.description: Flags U+FFFD and complete UTF-8 sequences that appear to have been decoded through Latin-1 or Windows-1252. Results are heuristics, not proof or repair.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON envelope. Tool endpoints reject profile and every unknown property.

bytes.summary: Submit original UTF-8 bytes as canonical Base64

findings.title: Possible UTF-8 bytes decoded as a legacy encoding

characters.name: LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A WITH TILDE

possible_intended_character.name: LATIN SMALL LETTER E WITH ACUTE

findings.explanation: These displayed characters map to one well-formed UTF-8 sequence when read as Latin-1 or Windows-1252 bytes.

post.description: Compares text with NFC, NFD, NFKC, and NFKD. It returns form flags, metrics, and bounded changed ranges instead of full normalized strings.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON envelope. Tool endpoints reject profile and every unknown property.

text.summary: Compare decomposed text with all four normalization forms

bytes.summary: Submit original UTF-8 bytes as canonical Base64

findings.title: Text differs from NFC

characters.name: LATIN SMALL LETTER E WITH ACUTE

findings.explanation: Normalizing with Unicode NFC changes the code-point sequence in this range. Normalization can affect exact matching and identifier comparison.

findings.title: Text differs from NFKC

characters.name: LATIN SMALL LETTER E WITH ACUTE

findings.explanation: Normalizing with Unicode NFKC changes the code-point sequence in this range. Normalization can affect exact matching and identifier comparison.

post.description: Summarizes writing systems and flags suspicious cross-script characters. Confusable matching is an explicitly versioned Greek/Cyrillic-to-ASCII curated subset, not complete UTS #39 data.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON envelope. Tool endpoints reject profile and every unknown property.

text.summary: Review a Cyrillic lookalike in Latin text

bytes.summary: Submit original UTF-8 bytes as canonical Base64

findings.title: Curated cross-script lookalike
findings.explanation: This non-Latin character resembles an ASCII Latin letter and appears in text that also uses Latin. Review it in names, links, and identifiers.

post.summary: Count UTF-8 and Unicode text units
post.description: Counts UTF-8 bytes, code points/scalars, locally segmented extended grapheme clusters, Unicode-aware words, CR/LF/CRLF lines, and UTF-16 JavaScript units.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON envelope. Tool endpoints reject profile and every unknown property.

text.summary: Count text containing non-ASCII and non-BMP characters

bytes.summary: Submit original UTF-8 bytes as canonical Base64

post.description: Validates the submitted inner text as JSON, accepts every standard top-level type, rejects NaN and infinities, and returns stable source locations. Invalid inner JSON is a successful HTTP 200 domain result.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON envelope. Tool endpoints reject profile and every unknown property.

text.summary: Locate a syntax error in submitted JSON text

bytes.summary: Submit original UTF-8 bytes as canonical Base64

post.description: Lists every code point with UTF-8 bytes, Unicode metadata, offsets, and a visible or escaped representation. This endpoint accepts at most 500 code points so its response is complete and bounded.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON envelope. Tool endpoints reject profile and every unknown property.

text.summary: Inspect a BMP letter and a non-BMP emoji

bytes.summary: Submit original UTF-8 bytes as canonical Base64

200.description: Every accepted code point was inspected.

unicode_version.description: Unicode database version supplied by the Python runtime.

value.description: Unicode scalar text whose UTF-8 encoding is at most 32 KiB.

base64.description: Canonical padded standard Base64 with no whitespace; decoded input is at most 32 KiB.

SourceLocation.description: Zero-based half-open byte, UTF-16, and scalar offsets with one-based line and column coordinates. End coordinates are present on Unicode-review findings.

visible.description: The character when printable, a dotted-circle form for a mark, or an escaped representation for controls, separators, and format characters.
